newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras finalizes Paris Club debt relief deal.
newsitem.headline: Honduras finalizes Paris Club debt relief deal.

text.p: The government of Honduras has finalized a debt relief agreement worth $125 million with Paris Club member countries, the Finance Minister said on Thursday.
The final agreement reached with the United States on Wednesday night forgave $4.4 million in Honduran debt and restructured another $7.6 million, said Finance Minister Juan Ferrera.
The Paris Club granted debt relief worth $125 million in March 1995 on overdue Honduran interest payments, which implied forgiving a part and restructuring the rest.
Honduras has debts of some $1.2 billion outstanding with the Paris Club, which it hopes will be partly forgiven by 1998.
"The agreement we signed with the United States was the last one to seal debt-relief negotiations with the Paris Club member countries," said Ferrara.
The debt-relief negotiations are conditional on the signing of a letter of intent with the International Monetary Fund.
